/* selectTransFoodList (교통비및식대 조회) - Lee Hye Sun */
/* 교통비 및 식대 기준 - 대면출석 (식비 5,000 + 교통비 3,000) = 8,000 - 비대면출석 (식비 5,000 + 교통비 2,000) = 7,000 - 지각('03'), 조퇴('04'), 외출('05'), 지조('07'), 지외('08'), 외조('09') => 3번 누적 시 -8,000원 */ SELECT C.INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , C.INST_NM /*기관명*/ , E.BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD AS PVSN_YMD_FROM /*제공시작일자*/ , B.PVSN_END_YMD AS PVSN_YMD_TO /*제공종료일자*/ , DEC_B64(G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT) AS TRPR_NM_ENCPT /*대상자명암호화*/ , G.TRPR_BRTH_YMD /*대상자출생일자*/ , G.TRPR_INFO_NO /*대상자정보번호*/ , A.SRVC_PVSN_NO /*서비스제공번호*/ , A.CASE_MNG_NO /*사례관리번호*/ , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO /*사례관리차수*/ , B.RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M1,0) - NVL(BB.DE1,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M1,0) - NVL(BB.DE1,0) END AS GIVE_MM_1 /*1월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M2,0) - NVL(BB.DE2,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M2,0) - NVL(BB.DE2,0) END AS GIVE_MM_2 /*2월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M3,0) - NVL(BB.DE3,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M3,0) - NVL(BB.DE3,0) END AS GIVE_MM_3 /*3월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M4,0) - NVL(BB.DE4,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M4,0) - NVL(BB.DE4,0) END AS GIVE_MM_4 /*4월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M5,0) - NVL(BB.DE5,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M5,0) - NVL(BB.DE5,0) END AS GIVE_MM_5 /*5월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M6,0) - NVL(BB.DE6,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M6,0) - NVL(BB.DE6,0) END AS GIVE_MM_6 /*6월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M7,0) - NVL(BB.DE7,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M7,0) - NVL(BB.DE7,0) END AS GIVE_MM_7 /*7월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M8,0) - NVL(BB.DE8,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M8,0) - NVL(BB.DE8,0) END AS GIVE_MM_8 /*8월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M9,0) - NVL(BB.DE9,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M9,0) - NVL(BB.DE9,0) END AS GIVE_MM_9 /*9월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M10,0) - NVL(BB.DE10,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M10,0) - NVL(BB.DE10,0) END AS GIVE_MM_10 /*10월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M11,0) - NVL(BB.DE11,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M11,0) - NVL(BB.DE11,0) END AS GIVE_MM_11 /*11월*/ , CASE WHEN NVL(AA.M12,0) - NVL(BB.DE12,0) > 160000 THEN 160000 ELSE NVL(AA.M12,0) - NVL(BB.DE12,0) END AS GIVE_MM_12 /*12월*/ FROM SEB510 A /*서비스제공대상자*/ JOIN SEB500 T0 /*서비스제공*/ ON T0.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND T0.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본*/ ON B.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO JOIN SAA000 C /*통합기관*/ ON C.INST_NO = B.RSFR_INST_NO JOIN SDA420 D /*서비스실행사업*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO JOIN SDA400 E /*서비스사업*/ ON E.SRVC_BIZ_NO = D.SRVC_BIZ_NO JOIN SEB100 F /*사례기본*/ ON F.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND F.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO JOIN SEA200 G /*대상자정보*/ ON G.TRPR_INFO_NO = F.TRPR_INFO_NO JOIN SEB530 H /*자원프로그램제공*/ ON H.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND H.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND H.SRVC_PVSN_NO = A.SRVC_PVSN_NO LEFT JOIN AFA330 I /*교육이수일정내역*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = I.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = I.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT A.CASE_MNG_NO , A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '01', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE1 /*1월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '02', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE2 /*2월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '03', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE3 /*3월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '04', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE4 /*4월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '05', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE5 /*5월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '06', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE6 /*6월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '07', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE7 /*7월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '08', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE8 /*8월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '09', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE9 /*9월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '10', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE10 /*10월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '11', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE11 /*11월*/ , TRUNC(COUNT(DECODE(SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5,2), '12', ATNC_SE_CD))/3)*8000 AS DE12 /*12월*/ FROM SEB530 A INNER JOIN SEB510 B ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
WHERE ATNC_SE_CD IN ('03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') AND B.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN #{BIZ_YR} || '0101' AND #{BIZ_YR} || '1231'
GROUP BY A.CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO )BB ON A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = BB.CASE_MNG_NO LEFT JOIN ( SELECT CASE_MNG_NO , CASE_MNG_ODRNO , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PTCPTN_YMD), 'YYYYMM') AS PMONTH , COUNT(PTCPTN_YMD) AS PTCPTN_YMD FROM SEB530 WHERE 1=1 AND RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN #{BIZ_YR} || '0101' AND #{BIZ_YR} || '1231'
GROUP BY CASE_MNG_NO, CASE_MNG_ODRNO, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(PTCPTN_YMD), 'YYYYMM') ) DD ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = DD.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = DD.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN ( /* 월별 총 교통비및식대(결석일수 빼기전) */ SELECT A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO , A.CASE_MNG_NO, /*1월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '01'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M1, /*2월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '02'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M2, /*3월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '03'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M3, /*4월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '04'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M4, /*5월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '05'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M5, /*6월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '06'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M6, /*7월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '07'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M7, /*8월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '08' THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M8, /*9월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '09'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M9, /*10월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '10'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M10, /*11월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '11'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M11, /*12월*/ SUM(CASE WHEN ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01', '03', '04', '05', '07', '08', '09') THEN --출석 CASE WHEN SUBSTR(PTCPTN_YMD, 5, 2) = '12'THEN CASE WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'Y' THEN 7000 --비대면 WHEN ONLINE_CLASS_YN = 'N' THEN 8000 --대면 ELSE 0 END END END) AS M12 FROM SEB530 A INNER JOIN SEB510 B ON A.SRVC_PVSN_NO = B.SRVC_PVSN_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = B.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
WHERE 1=1 AND B.RESRCE_NO = #{RESRCE_NO} AND B.DEL_YN ='N' AND PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN #{BIZ_YR} || '0101' AND #{BIZ_YR} || '1231'
GROUP BY A.CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ) AA ON A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = AA.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND A.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND C.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND T0.DEL_YN = 'N' AND E.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND C.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND B.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
GROUP BY C.INST_NO, C.INST_NM, E.BIZ_YR, B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM, B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD, B.PVSN_END_YMD, G.TRPR_NM_ENCPT , G.TRPR_BRTH_YMD, G.TRPR_INFO_NO, A.SRVC_PVSN_NO, A.CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, B.RESRCE_NO , AA.M1, AA.M2, AA.M3, AA.M4, AA.M5, AA.M6, AA.M7, AA.M8, AA.M9, AA.M10, AA.M11, AA.M12 , BB.DE1, BB.DE2 , BB.DE3, BB.DE4, BB.DE5, BB.DE6, BB.DE7, BB.DE8, BB.DE9, BB.DE10, BB.DE11, BB.DE12
ORDER BY B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM
